claims.claim_text: RA 9266 IRR Section 3(27) retains copyright ownership in the architect unless there is a written stipulation to the contrary.
RA 9266 IRR Section 3(32) limits commissioned ownership to execution of the original project and excludes repetitions or subsequent projects.
RA 9266 IRR Section 33 prohibits copying or use for repetition or other projects without the architect's written consent.
